standard_vs_dialects.standard_japanese_hyoujungo: Based on Tokyo Yamanote dialect; utilized in broadcasting, legal, and educational spheres.

tohoku.phonetics: Voicing of intervocalic stops, high vowel centralizing

kyushu.aspect: Distinct markers for progressive (〜よる) vs perfective resultative (〜とる)

registers.business_mail: Hyper-polite Kenjougo and Sonkeigo (平素より大変お世話になっております, 幸甚に存じます).
registers.newspaper_editorial: Strict Joutai / Dearu (〜である, 〜とみられる, 〜を明らかにした).
registers.manga_conversational: Rich onomatopoeia, expressive sentence-final particles, colloquial contractions.

historical_classical_japanese_bungo.legacy_grammar: Classical auxiliaries preserved in set phrases, proverbs, and legal statutes.

gendered_speech_evolution.traditional: Feminine speech (わ, かしら, お- prefixation) vs Masculine speech (ぞ, ぜ, 俺, 飯).
gendered_speech_evolution.contemporary_reality: Significant convergence among youth toward neutral conversational markers (ね, よ, じゃん); flagged as descriptive stylistic traits rather than prescriptive mandates.
